title.en: One Day in the Life of Ivan Denisovich: five complete new editions
title.zh: 《伊凡·杰尼索维奇的一天》：新增五语全文
title.zh-hant: 《伊凡·傑尼索維奇的一天》：新增五語全文

summary.en: Three essays on the confession, the wall and the biscuit outside the ledger. Five complete new editions follow the fact-checked Chinese prose; independent English receives local corrections.
summary.zh: 三篇从口供、墙到不入账的饼干，核修原著事实，保留英文独立散文，补齐日法德西韩全文。
summary.zh-hant: 三篇從口供、牆到不入賬的餅乾，核修原著事實，保留英文獨立散文，補齊日法德西韓全文。
